title: Handoff notes
description: Decisions, open questions, risks and observations for one feature. Rendered by the Notes page, read-only in the site and authored here.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within this file. Prefix 'n-', kebab-case.

kind.description: What sort of entry this is. Drives the filter chips and the label.

title.description: The point, in one line. For a decision, say what was decided.

body.description: The reasoning. For a decision, say what it costs as well as what it buys.

author.description: Who recorded it. Shown as an avatar and a name.

status.description: Short state, e.g. 'needs research'. Most useful on questions and risks.

reference.description: Optional external reference, shown as a link on the card.

affects.description: Page titles this note governs, rendered as jump links. Each must match a page the feature actually exports — the validator checks this.
